original_target.title: Sunada’s no-gap conjecture for abelian covers
original_target.area: Wave spectra on periodic curved spaces

scope_comparison: The August heat-propagation paper proves heat-kernel asymptotics on Abelian covers and a spectral gap for nontrivial principal-bundle fiber modes. It does not show that the surface maximal-Abelian-cover Laplacian has every E>=0 in its spectrum. Sunada's no-gap target is distinct from gap labeling of periodic graph Jacobi matrices.
